name: Harrison Ruffin Tyler
bioAdditions: Last living grandchild of President John Tyler; the span from the president's birth to his death was 235 years (S1). 7th cousin 4 times removed. No public-domain or freely licensed photograph was found on Commons (his Wikipedia article has no lead image).
funFacts: A grandson of a president born in 1790 lived until 2025: 235 years across three generations.
